description: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets associated with data sources labeled “1” over the years 2012 through 2022. The horizontal axis represents “Year,” with labels ranging from 2012 to 2022 in sequential order, and the vertical axis represents “Number of datasets,” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. Two sets of bars are displayed for each year: orange bars representing one data source and blue bars representing another. The orange bars range in height from approximately 1 in 2012 to 45 in 2021, while the blue bars range from approximately 1 in 2012 to 105 in 2022. Specifically, the orange bar for 2012 is approximately 1 unit high, while the blue bar for 2022 reaches approximately 105 units. The bars are arranged chronologically by year and are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
